t: Scruffs Worker Plus work trousers are durable polycotton workwear designed for frequent use by trade professionals. These black robust trousers feature reinforced bottom-loading knees and a reinforced crotch, ensuring comfort and longevity for tasks such as building, plumbing, and electrical work. The fabric is water-repellent, offering protection in damp conditions, and the triple-stitched seams enhance overall strength. Practicality is key, with 11 multi-functional pockets for essential tools and a convenient hammer strap. Made from a breathable 65% cotton and 35% polyester blend, these machine washable trousers also include seven belt loops and a straight leg design with a zip fly.
